defs.d: A large settlement, bigger than a town; sometimes with a specific legal definition, depending on the place.
defs.ex: São Paulo is the largest city in South America.

defs.d: A settlement granted special status by royal charter or letters patent; traditionally, a settlement with a cathedral regardless of size.
(with a possessive pronoun) Everything that one is capable of.
defs.ex: She gave her all, and collapsed at the finish line.

defs.d: The totality of one's possessions.
All gone; dead.
defs.ex: The butter is all.

defs.d: (degree) Intensifier.
defs.ex: It suddenly went all quiet.

defs.d: Entirely; completely; totally.
A measure of the extent of a surface; it is measured in square units.
A particular geographic region.
All people.
Distant; remote in space.
defs.ex: He went to a far land.

defs.d: Remote in time.
defs.ex: the far future

defs.d: To, from or over a great distance in space, time or other extent.
defs.ex: He built a time machine and travelled far into the future.

defs.d: Very much; by a great amount.
defs.ex: He was far richer than we'd thought.

defs.d: (usually academic) To review materials already learned in order to make sure one does not forget them, usually in preparation for an examination.
defs.ex: I need to study my biology notes.

defs.d: (academic) To take a course or courses on a subject.
defs.ex: I study medicine at the university.

defs.d: To rest in a state of reduced consciousness.
defs.ex: You should sleep 8 hours a day.

defs.d: (of a spinning top or yo-yo) To spin on its axis with no other perceptible motion.
Regardless; anyhow.
defs.ex: He didn't enjoy washing his car, but it was so dirty that he did it anyway.

defs.d: Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement. See anyhow and at least.
defs.ex: I don't think that's true. I haven't found any evidence, anyway.

defs.d: A large, highly organized military force, concerned mainly with ground (rather than air or naval) operations.
defs.ex: The army was sent in to quell the uprising.

defs.d: The governmental agency in charge of a state's army.
defs.ex: The army opposed the legislature's involvement.

defs.d: A daily log of experiences, especially those of the writer.
defs.ex: They kept separate diaries. His was on paper and her diary was on her computer's hard drive.

defs.d: A personal organizer or appointment diary.
To keep a diary or journal.
Lasting for one day.
The distance from the base of something to the top.
The vertical distance from the ground to the highest part of a standing person or animal (withers in the case of a horse).
One of a set of choices that can be made.
The freedom or right to choose.
To purchase an option on something.
defs.ex: The new novel was optioned by the film studio, but they'll probably never decide to make a movie from it.

defs.d: To configure, by setting an option.
To declare formally, officially or ceremoniously.
defs.ex: I hereby pronounce you man and wife.

defs.d: To declare authoritatively, or as a formal expert opinion.
defs.ex: The doctor pronounced them legally dead.

defs.d: To make a living; earn money for necessities.
defs.ex: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.

defs.d: To act to prepare for something.
defs.ex: Provide against disaster.

defs.d: A composer, conductor, or performer of music; specifically, a person who sings and/or plays a musical instrument as a hobby, an occupation, or a profession.
(chiefly in the plural) A narrow passage, especially a contracted part of a stream, lake, or sea; a strait connecting two bodies of water.
defs.ex: the narrows of New York harbor

defs.d: Having a small width; not wide; having opposite edges or sides that are close, especially by comparison to length or depth.
defs.ex: a narrow hallway

defs.d: Of little extent; very limited; circumscribed.
A submicroscopic, non-cellular structure consisting of a core of DNA or RNA surrounded by a protein coat, that requires a living host cell to replicate, and often causes disease in the host organism.
A disease caused by these organisms.
defs.ex: He caught a virus and had to stay home from school.

defs.d: The tendency to attract.
defs.ex: The Moon is held in its orbit by the attraction of the Earth's gravity.

defs.d: The feeling of being attracted.
defs.ex: I felt a strange attraction towards the place.

defs.d: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.
defs.ex: There was lots of wood on the beach.

defs.d: The wood of a particular species of tree.
defs.ex: Teak is much used for outdoor benches, but a number of other woods are also suitable, such as ipé, redwood, etc.

defs.d: To cover or plant with trees.
To hide behind trees.
A curve.
defs.ex: There's a sharp bend in the road ahead.

defs.d: Any of the various knots which join the ends of two lines.
To cause (something) to change its shape into a curve, by physical force, chemical action, or any other means.
defs.ex: Don’t bend your knees.

defs.d: To become curved.
defs.ex: Look at the trees bending in the wind.

defs.d: Serving to reduce a difficulty, or accessible with minimum difficulty; expedient.
defs.ex: Fast food might be convenient, but it's also very unhealthy.

defs.d: Fit; suitable; appropriate.
To mentally support; to motivate, give courage, hope or spirit.
defs.ex: I encouraged him during his race.

defs.d: To spur on, strongly recommend.
defs.ex: We encourage the use of bicycles in the town centre.

defs.d: To spend money, time, or energy on something, especially for some benefit or purpose; used with in.
defs.ex: We'd like to thank all the contributors who have invested countless hours into this event.

defs.d: To clothe or wrap (with garments).
A particular point or place in physical space.
An act of locating.
Belief in a spiritual or metaphysical reality (often including at least one deity), accompanied by practices or rituals pertaining to the belief.
defs.ex: My brother tends to value religion, but my sister not as much.

defs.d: A particular system of such belief, and the rituals and practices proper to it.
defs.ex: Eckankar is a new religion but Zoroastrianism is an old religion.

defs.d: Engage in religious practice.
Indoctrinate into a specific religion.
The quality or state of being popular; especially, the state of being esteemed by, or of being in favor with, the people at large
defs.ex: Politicians are rarely known for their popularity.

defs.d: The quality or state of being adapted or pleasing to common, poor, or vulgar people; hence, cheapness; inferiority; vulgarity.
Strained; drawn close; tight.
defs.ex: strict embrace

defs.d: Tense; not relaxed.
defs.ex: strict fiber
